caption: The drawing features two renderings of a dress, both viewed from the back. The main object on the right is a detailed colored illustration of a dress with a fitted waist, a flared skirt with ruffled layers, and long, puffed sleeves. The dress appears to be made from a patterned fabric with a small, repetitive design in dark tones on a light background. The dress has pink trim accents along the collar, cuffs, pocket, and ruffle seams. There is a small pocket on the right side of the skirt, also bordered with pink trim. The collar is wide and angled, and the sleeves are gathered at the shoulders, creating additional volume. To the left and slightly below this main illustration, there is a smaller, monochrome sketch of the same dress, showing its shape and structure without any color or pattern, emphasizing outline and construction details. Both dresses are centered on a plain, light beige background with no other objects or elements present.
title: Child's Dress
